body: **Working entry (verbatim, title and scope hint; `chk-alpfcbcr`):** Upstream sync ahead of polish and ship — upstream/main merged, changes mostly additive; CI, a11y leg and audit green, per-OS tallies re-read, sink allowlist re-checked

**Intent anchor:** `escher-0.3.0/vision.md`: "Upstream is merged at each epoch boundary while our changes stay mostly additive." Additivity is a preference, not a goal: where staying additive would force contorted logic, the upstream code is changed directly and the change says so. This is the first entry of Epoch 6 «Polish & ship», ahead of «Answer writer by family» (`chk-br6huuk6`, placed second on the founder's word), which splits `packages/escher-driver/src/json.rs` on the synced tree. P4 checks each unclaimed cap's requirement line; this chunk is expected to claim none.

**The operator's directive at this invocation (relay, to be snapped) [inferred]:** "Upstream sync ahead of polish and ship. One thing to weigh in the plan: give the CI disk reds a line — `Test [default features]` has no free-disk step, and two reds on runner image 20261018.96.1 (`Stand checks repeated` at 42eed99a6, `Test [default features]` at 361d8bd27) correlate with disk; hypothesis, not measured on that image."

- **The sync, this fork's twelfth upstream take [inferred].**
  - **The pin.** `upstream/main` was fetched at the take-up and reads `e5305a4c1` ("Clamp scroll offsets after layout during layout rounding (#1624)", committed 2026-11-17T11:43:28Z). The last take read `ea07ee716`; `git rev-list --count ea07ee716..upstream/main` reads 10.
  - **What the 10 bring (by subject, unmeasured):** external images in inline and top-level SVG (`7b8712cba`); AnyRender bumps — git `f749ad5` (`1311a45e4`), git main with the vello hybrid backend renamed `gpu` (`92df4760c`), then **AnyRender 0.15 from crates.io** (`81b489684`); root SVG background painting (`2203de767`); propagated root and body backgrounds painted only on the canvas (`c5940f038`); synthetic italic/oblique shear direction (`d02c094c7`); scroll offsets clamped after layout during layout rounding (`e5305a4c1`); WPT-only changes (`e8b370a25`, `585c1869c`).
  - **AnyRender moved back to the registry [inferred]:** upstream's manifest at `e5305a4c1` names `anyrender = "0.15.0"`, `anyrender_serialize = "0.9.0"`, `anyrender_skia = "0.13.0"`; ours stands on anyrender 0.14. The AnyRender git-pin chain every earlier take left out (and the commits chained to it) may now be takeable with no git dependency. P3 measures which of the left-out delta this releases, against the left-out table's measured reasons.
  - **Taffy.** Upstream's manifest at `e5305a4c1` pins git Taffy `a3997d55…`, the same rev ours pins since «Taffy past #1372» — no Taffy move is expected (`cry-hbkcvbxr` re-read below).
  - **Still-held pins [inferred]:** upstream names Dioxus `0.8.0-alpha.3` and parley 0.13; ours Dioxus 0.7.3 and parley 0.12. A commit that needs either stays out with its measured reason.
  - **The shape follows the precedent of the last takes:** a cherry-pick onto this fork's pins, measured on a fresh trial worktree under `target/tmp/`, picks as `git -c rerere.enabled=false cherry-pick …`; each commit left out keeps its measured reason.

- **Conflicts are measured at P3** (`git merge-tree`, then the trial). Every resolution keeps both sides' intent: the changed set's contract, the clock invariant, the select model and its list, the hit stops and the scrolled-box bounds, the reversed scroll origins and the into-view readings, the stable ids and the snapshot, the range and keyboard models, `inert`, and the accessibility state reads. `e5305a4c1` (scroll-offset clamping at layout rounding) touches the scrolling surface escher's `scroll_into_view`, `visible_region` and scrolled-box bounds read [inferred].
- **Upstream's new and edited test files** run under the take under this fork's blitz-tests rule: one file and one target per behaviour, pinned by `.github/scripts/test_blitz_tests_targets.py`.

- **Every escher proof still passes after the take:** `bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh fast` and `doc`; the stand checks in both layout modes; the incremental/non-incremental oracle; the **a11y leg** and the **dependency audit**; the `embolden` witness; the screenshot readings (a paint change — AnyRender 0.15, canvas backgrounds, shear — may move pixels; a moved reading is re-measured and recorded, never loosened); fork CI green on the pushed commit, every job settled.
- **Per-OS tallies re-read:** the test-bearing job logs of the take's own green CI run, re-read by the test plan's method, each moved count explained.

- **Sink allowlist re-checked:** the taken delta read for every new `tracing`/`log` call site, target, print and env read; the standing capture checks stay at 0 needles (`packages/escher-telemetry/src/format.rs`).

- **The CI disk reds, given a line (the operator's directive) [inferred]:** the directive's claim, kept verbatim as a hypothesis: "two reds on runner image 20261018.96.1 (`Stand checks repeated` at 42eed99a6, `Test [default features]` at 361d8bd27) correlate with disk; hypothesis, not measured on that image." At HEAD `.github/workflows/ci.yml` gives `Stand checks repeated` a `Free Disk Space (Ubuntu)` step (`jlumbroso/free-disk-space`, pinned) and `Test [default features]` none. P3 reads both runs' logs (the failing step, its error text, the runner image) to measure whether disk caused each red; the plan gives the finding its line — a free-disk step for `Test [default features]` (under `WorkflowPinTest`'s SHA pin and `test_ci_workflows.py`'s invariants) where the logs show disk, or the measured other cause stated where they do not.
Trail: `.andromeda/runs/2026-11-17T11-43-12-phase/ci-no-marker.json`.
| Sha | Run | Verdict | Wall |
| `c74c7f3e6` | CI#44076271917 | in progress (checks 4/4) | — |
- `CI c74c7f3e6: verdict not yet available`. It is the 0-pending wrap's route-only commit; its verdict is unread, never folded as green, and is re-read at P3 and before this chunk's push.
- No red to fold.
Every block of `chk-alpfcbcr`: seven, all `CARRY:` (the `pins` view), each read whole from the record.

- **The mounted-event test (`cry-o26emj4y`) [inferred]:** "upstream's `6ef4b532d` test `element_removed_before_its_mounted_event_is_flushed` stayed out, reading 1 mounted event on Dioxus 0.7 where it asserts 0 (measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-11-01-upstream-sync-ui-graph/report.md); it returns with the Dioxus 0.8 move, not with `286874cc1`'s buffered render, which was ported onto the 0.7 bridge without it and moves no scheduling (measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-11-07-mounteddata-buffered-render/report.md); re-read as standing at 2026-11-13-upstream-sync-determinism-and-exploration, the pins unmoved and Dioxus 0.7.3; rode on from Upstream sync ahead of errors and explanation, untouched by its take". It returns only with the Dioxus 0.8 move.

- **The buffered render's merge surface (`cry-mnnoitsu`) [inferred]:** "the merge surface of 2026-11-07-mounteddata-buffered-render's buffered render, flagged not upstreamable with nothing sent: `packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/dioxus_document.rs` (the two render sites, the `buffered_mutations` field, the ported `task_polled_during_render_can_access_document`), `mutation_buffer.rs` (escher's own file, which upstream's 0.8 `mutation_buffer.rs` replaces whole when the 0.8 move is taken) and `lib.rs` (one `mod` line); re-read at the take that brings the 0.8 move (record: escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-11-07-mounteddata-buffered-render/report.md); rode on from Upstream sync ahead of errors and explanation, untouched by its take".

- **`handle_click`'s arm functions (`cry-hvl3d4gp`) [inferred]:** "`handle_click`'s arms, upstream's included, stand as private `click_*` functions in `packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs` since 2026-11-13-cognitive-load-corrective (measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-11-13-cognitive-load-corrective/report.md), so an upstream commit that edits a `handle_click` arm does not pick cleanly and is re-applied by hand to its arm function, the price test-plan `decision/complexity-ceiling-host-only`'s `except` names; rode on from Upstream sync ahead of errors and explanation, untouched by its take". P3 reads whether a taken commit edits `events/pointer.rs`.

- **The `Request::get` ban (`cry-fdvxodkv`) [inferred]:** "escher's `packages/blitz-dom/clippy.toml` (since 2026-11-13-local-files-for-local-documents) bans `Request::get` in blitz-dom outside `stamped_request`, and upstream's blitz-dom has none — a take that adds an upstream sub-resource `Request::get` there routes it through `stamped_request` with its document's URL, the clippy leg red until it does (measured at that chunk's control, `9.without-expect.log`, exit 101); an upstream edit to a `StylesheetHandler` construction or a `fetch_font_face` caller takes the new `document_url`; rode on from Upstream sync ahead of errors and explanation, untouched by its take". `7b8712cba` loads external images in SVG — a new sub-resource load on every document, remote pages included — so P3 reads it against this ban and against blitz-net's `file:` refusal (`FileForbidden`) [inferred].

- **The merge surfaces (`cry-blhcfqeb`) [inferred]:** "the merge surfaces: the panic's fix in `BaseDocument::deallocate_anonymous_block` and the earlier takes' resolutions, each flagged upstreamable with nothing sent; re-read row by row at this take (records: escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-11-01-upstream-sync-ui-graph/evidence/readings.md and escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-11-13-upstream-sync-determinism-and-exploration/evidence/readings.md; moved on from Upstream sync ahead of determinism and exploration, its re-read there); rode on from Upstream sync ahead of errors and explanation, untouched by its take". Re-read row by row at this take.

- **The CDP listener (`cry-7rsyw6me`) [inferred]:** "the CDP server's served listener (`127.0.0.1` via `BLITZ_CDP_PORT`) arrives with any take of `a1670ef1b` — a security-plan amendment first (arch §Occupied Resources and the security plan's surfaces), before the take lands; placed on the operator's word on 2026-11-13-upstream-sync-determinism-and-exploration's P5 card, row 3 (chunks/2026-11-13-upstream-sync-determinism-and-exploration/inputs/I3-relay-3.md.txt); rode on from Upstream sync ahead of errors and explanation, untouched by its take". `a1670ef1b` stays out unless the take cannot stand without it; any take of it is a security-plan amendment first.

- **The Taffy merge surface (`cry-hbkcvbxr`) [inferred]:** "the merge surface of 2026-11-15-taffy-from-upstream-git, ratified for its take and flagged not upstreamable with nothing sent: the root manifest's `taffy` line on git Taffy `e90751fd` and its lock package, taken by no-commit pick of upstream's eight Taffy-bump commits `1a11761bc` … `ccfe15332`, with `1a11761bc`'s `place_floated_box` line in `packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/inline/layout.rs` as upstream wrote it; a merge re-reads them against upstream's pin after «Taffy past #1372 — reversed scroll origins» (record: escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-11-15-taffy-from-upstream-git/evidence/take.md)". Re-read against upstream's pin `a3997d55…` at `e5305a4c1`.

- **The left-out delta's table** (the last take's carry, its reasons in `escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-11-15-upstream-sync-errors-and-explanation/` records and the earlier `lock.md`) [inferred]: each reason is re-read against `e5305a4c1`; a reason that no longer holds — the AnyRender git pin above first — puts that commit back in the take.
- **The workspace takes no git dependency** save Taffy's pinned rev (CLAUDE.md Critical Warnings; `.claude/rules/security.md` §Dependencies). A taken AnyRender comes from the registry.
- **Coupled dependency pins:** a take carries upstream's pins as one set or none. A moved layout, text or paint number is re-measured and recorded, never loosened to pass.
- **dioxus-native-dom** (ids, snapshot, graph, reached record, buffered render) and **the engine surfaces escher changed** keep escher's behaviour; each resolution recorded.

- **Boundary widenings [inferred]:** external image loads in SVG (`7b8712cba`) are a new fetch on every document, remote pages included; the background and shear changes are engine changes for every document. Each one the take carries is listed for the operator at P4, never settled silently, and checked against the playbook's escalate patterns.
- **CI workflow edits** keep every action pinned to a 40-hex SHA (`WorkflowPinTest`) and `ci.yml`'s read-only `contents: read` permission.
- **MSRV stays 1.91.** New and removed dependencies reviewed by hand and through the audit's licence check.
- **Additivity:** edits of ours to upstream-owned code limited to what a conflict, a gate failure or a ruled fork requires; each named and recorded.
- **No new crate, port, env var or listener of ours.**
- **Disk:** `target/` reads 690 GB with 190 GB free on the drive (the handoff); a clean before the sync's builds is the operator's call [inferred].
- «Answer writer by family» and every later entry.
- Sending our changes upstream.
- The Dioxus 0.8 move and parley 0.13.
- Bumping any dependency beyond upstream's own registry set.
- Upstream's WPT conformance numbers.

body: - **Depth:** deep · **Reads:** 19 · **Globs/Greps:** 24

- **Harness rules consulted:** `.claude/rules/testing.md` (auto-loaded with the `tests/` read; its Session Additions applied: count results only under `--no-fail-fast`, 2026-10-09; a test pinning a value is re-measured, never loosened); `.claude/rules/host-linux.md` (picks as `git -c rerere.enabled=false cherry-pick`, 2026-10-27; relative `target/tmp/` trial path, 2026-10-13)

- **Platform issues consulted:** web search `actions runner-images ubuntu-24.04 20261018 "ld terminated with signal 7" bus error disk space` → no runner-images issue names image 20261018.96.1 or this signature; the one fetched-relevant hit, golang/go#41473 ("signal SIGBUS: bus error during linking with sufficient disk space"), states a linker SIGBUS can occur with disk to spare — so disk is not the only cause the signature admits. The two jobs' own annotations (`gh api repos/Turbolet85/escher/check-runs/{job}/annotations`) carry only the Node.js 20 deprecation warning, the exit-101 failure and the `ubuntu-latest` → Ubuntu 26 migration notice (runner-images#14748) — no disk annotation.

- **External inputs:** `inputs#I1` — the operator's directive at the invocation: give the CI disk reds a line, a hypothesis not measured on image 20261018.96.1 · `inputs#I2` — the operator's mid-P2 relay: CI#44076271917 on `c74c7f3e6` red at «Dependency audit» on RUSTSEC-2026-0545 and RUSTSEC-2026-0548 (zip 2.4.2 ← anyrender_serialize 0.8.0 ← browser, fix zip ≥ 9.0.5); measure whether upstream moves anyrender_serialize off zip 2.x and take it into the plan

Worktree `target/tmp/trial-pas` (detached at `c74c7f3e6`), upstream `main` `e5305a4c1` (fetched at the take-up, `git log -1 upstream/main`), `git rev-list --count ea07ee716..upstream/main` = 10. Each commit trial-picked alone onto HEAD (`git -c rerere.enabled=false cherry-pick --no-commit`), conflicts counted by `<<<<<<<` markers:
| Commit | Subject | Pick on HEAD | Disposition |

| `7b8712cba` | Load external images in inline and top-level SVG (#1587) | 1 conflict, `node/serialize.rs`: upstream's side is a `#[cfg(all(test, feature = "svg"))] mod tests` that tests `8228d15f3`'s `svg_source()` namespaces (left out at the last take); ours empty | **takeable**: keep ours (drop the module); `cargo check` and `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` on `blitz-dom --features svg --locked` exit 0, so `packages/blitz-dom/clippy.toml`'s `Request::get` ban holds (the fetch goes through `BaseDocument::build_request`, `document.rs:660`); `Cargo.lock` +1 line (`png` under blitz-dom's `svg` feature) |
| `1311a45e4` | Bump anyrender to f749ad5 (#1601) | conflict `Cargo.toml` · `Cargo.lock` | pin mover (git AnyRender) — out |

| `2203de767` | Avoid repainting the root SVG background outside its image (#1604) | 4 conflicts, `node/serialize.rs` | chained on the left-out SVG serialize chain (`414b89b59` → `8228d15f3`, `lock.md` of 2026-11-15) — out |

| `c5940f038` | Paint propagated root and body background colors only on the canvas (#1605) | 3 conflicts (`render.rs`, `render/background.rs`, `render/box_shadow.rs`) | chained: its box-shadow hunk reads `bg_covers_border_box`, introduced by the left-out `fcdf67aea` (#1533, "textual conflict on a skipped chain … box_shadow.rs — stands", `lock.md:167`); `canvas_background_node_id` is its own (`git log -S`) — out |
| `92df4760c` | Bump anyrender to main and rename vello hybrid backend to gpu (#1606) | conflicts in 7 files (`ci.yml`, manifests, `dioxus_renderer.rs`, examples) | pin mover (git AnyRender) — out |
| `e8b370a25` | wpt: remove float, calc and direction test flags (#1607) | clean | **take** |
| `81b489684` | Upgrade to AnyRender 0.15 from crates.io (#1608) | conflict `Cargo.toml` · `Cargo.lock` | the registry AnyRender move — the fork below |

| `d02c094c7` | Fix: synthetic italic/oblique shears in wrong direction | conflict: `blitz-paint/src/text.rs` (ours reshaped) and `parley_code_editor/src/paint.rs` (absent here, modify/delete) | **take by hand**: the one sign change at `packages/blitz-paint/src/text.rs:641`; the editor half has no file here |
| `585c1869c` | Bump WPT pin to 92d3795 (#1625) | clean | **take** |

| `e5305a4c1` | Clamp scroll offsets after layout during layout rounding (#1624) | 2 conflicts: `document.rs` (upstream's side sits on the left-out stylo `make_media_data`/`restyle_for_device_change` chain; its own hunk deletes one line) and `scrolling.rs` (imports) | **takeable**: keep ours minus `self.scroll_viewport_by(0.0, 0.0); // Clamp scroll offset` in `flush_pending_device_changes`; imports `use crate::{BaseDocument, BoundingRect, Node};`; `cargo check -p blitz-dom --locked` exit 0; #1602, which it "builds on", never landed on `main` alone (`git log upstream/main` holds no #1602), so nothing more is owed |

**The five-commit take** (`7b8712cba` resolved · `e8b370a25` · `d02c094c7` by hand · `585c1869c` · `e5305a4c1` resolved), built by `take.sh` on the trial: 18 files, +291 −157 (`git diff --cached --stat`). Readings on it:
- `bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh fast`: fmt and clippy green, test red at `stand_act_scroll` (cargo stopped there).

- `cargo test --workspace --locked --no-fail-fast`: **1546 passed · 1 failed · 15 ignored** (summed `test result` lines of the log); the one failure is `stand_act_scroll::a_row_past_the_list_is_refused_scrolled_into_view_and_then_clicked`, `incremental=false: Crud: the first row's centre now lies outside the list's box` at `tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_scroll.rs:248`. The two `error_text_host_*` panics in the log are those tests' own planted panics, each reading `ok`.
- Bisected: `e5305a4c1` alone on HEAD reads the same red; HEAD alone reads `6 passed` (`cargo test -p blitz-tests --locked --test stand_act_scroll`).
- `ci-scripts` · `embolden` · `doc` · `a11y` legs: exit 0 each.
- Not run on the trial: `audit` (red at HEAD regardless — below), `msrv`, `stand-repeat`, `coverage`.

**The `stand_act_scroll` red's mechanism.** Every assertion up to the delete holds (lines 185–246). After the click on `crud-delete` removes the last row, the list's content is one row shorter; `e5305a4c1` clamps a node's scroll offset when final layout is written (`clamp_node_scroll_offset` at layout rounding, `layout/construct.rs`, `resolve.rs`), so the list's `scroll_y` drops to the new maximum and the first row's centre reads inside the list's box — where HEAD left the offset past the shrunken content. The assertion at :248–256 pins the unclamped reading. A browser clamps a scroll offset to the new range on content shrink (the commit's stated intent), so the new reading is upstream's corrected behaviour for every document; the check's last two assertions are re-measured on the take and re-pinned to the clamped reading, never loosened.

- **Reproduced locally:** `bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh audit` exits 1, `target/ci-logs/audit.log:108` `advisories FAILED, licenses ok`, on exactly RUSTSEC-2026-0545 (`audit.log:7-26`) and RUSTSEC-2026-0548 (`audit.log:28-45`), each `zip v2.4.2 └── anyrender_serialize v0.8.0 └── browser v0.0.0`, `Cargo.lock:908`.

- **What they reach:** 0545 affects reading AES-encrypted entries with a password (`ZipArchive::by_name_decrypt`) "with the `aes-crypto` feature" (`audit.log:19`); 0548 affects `ZipStreamReader::visit` / `::extract` and `read_zipfile_from_stream` (`audit.log:36`). Our zip 2.4.2's lock entry depends on `arbitrary · crc32fast · crossbeam-utils · displaydoc · flate2 · indexmap · memchr · thiserror · zopfli` — no `aes`, `hmac` or `pbkdf2` (`Cargo.lock`, the `zip` package), so `aes-crypto` is off. `anyrender_serialize 0.8.0` (`~/.cargo/registry/src/…/anyrender_serialize-0.8.0/src/lib.rs`) calls `ZipWriter::new` (:524), `ZipArchive::new` (:562) and `by_name` (:566, :579, :588, :614) alone — no `by_name_decrypt`, no `ZipStreamReader`, no `read_zipfile_from_stream` (`grep -n "zip::\|ZipArchive\|ZipStreamReader\|decrypt\|by_name\|ZipWriter\|read_zipfile"`). Neither advisory's code is reached.

- **Does upstream move off zip 2.x? Yes, at `81b489684`.** Upstream's `Cargo.lock` by commit (`git show {c}:Cargo.lock`): `ea07ee716` · `7b8712cba` · `1311a45e4` · `92df4760c` read `zip 2.4.2` with a git `anyrender_serialize 0.8.0`; `81b489684` and `e5305a4c1` read **`anyrender_serialize 0.9.0` from the registry and `zip 9.6.0`** (≥ 9.0.5, the stated fix). In upstream's lock `anyrender_serialize` is zip's only dependent.

- **What the registry AnyRender move costs here (measured on the trial):** upstream's manifest at `e5305a4c1` names `anyrender 0.15.0 · anyrender_serialize 0.9.0 · anyrender_skia 0.13.0 · anyrender_vello 0.16.0 · anyrender_vello_cpu 0.19.0 · anyrender_vello_gpu 0.12.0` (the renamed hybrid) `· anyrender_svg 0.16.0 · wgpu_context 0.11.0`, `vello 0.12`, `vello_cpu/gpu/common 0.4`, `usvg 0.50.0`. Set on the trial (`bump_anyrender.py`, the hybrid kept under its key by `package = "anyrender_vello_gpu"`), `cargo update -w` exits 0 with **no Stylo, winit, parley, Dioxus or Taffy move** — skrifa 0.49 / read-fonts 0.46 join beside our 0.44 / 0.41, `zip v2.4.2 -> v9.6.1`. `cargo check --workspace --all-targets` then exits 101 at blitz-paint alone, **50 errors**: 46 × `fill`/`stroke` missing argument #6 `AntiAliasing` (anyrender-0.15.0 `src/lib.rs:248`), 2 × a 7-argument method (`render/box_shadow.rs`), 1 × an 12-argument glyph call (`text.rs`), 1 × `filters.rs`; across `render.rs` 9, `form_controls.rs` 9, `text.rs` 8, `border.rs` 7, `select_list.rs` 5 (escher's own file), `background.rs` 4, `box_shadow.rs` 4, `debug_overlay.rs` 3, `filters.rs` 1. Downstream crates (dioxus-native's renderer and its `vello_hybrid` → `gpu` rename, apps/browser's capture, examples, wpt/runner) were not reached by that check. Given by the founder by dialog in the overseer session, answered by 2026-11-17 13:23Z, and relayed by the
overseer. Each answer is his chosen label, verbatim, beside the builder's own option name.

## 1. The red «Dependency audit» (RUSTSEC-2026-0545 and RUSTSEC-2026-0548 on zip 2.4.2)
The three options as they were read to him: the two ignores by ID plus a new route entry for AnyRender 0.15 ·
AnyRender 0.15 taken in this sync (about 50 blitz-paint sites, the dioxus-native rename, the browser, examples
and wpt; paint moves for every document, the screenshot readings unmeasured, the chunk about twice its size) ·
the two ignores alone.

His answer: «Взять AnyRender 0.15 в этом sync»

The builder's option of the same meaning: «Take AnyRender 0.15 here».

## 2. Upstream's 7b8712cba, external images for SVG `<image>` / `<use>` href on every document
The question said it is a boundary widening that arrives by an upstream merge, that the request goes through the
stamped `build_request` and the `file:` refusal holds, and gave two options: take it, or leave it out.

His answer: «Взять (Recommended)»

It is his own word for the widening, given before the plan: the take is ratified by it. The builder's nearest
option is «Take it, founder at wrap»; the wrap's card cites this file and needs no second question to him.

Built on the trial over the five-commit take, saved as `take-anyrender.patch` (36 files, +714 −434, `git diff --cached --stat`), each piece measured:

- **The pins:** the root manifest's AnyRender set moves to upstream's registry versions (`anyrender 0.15.0 · anyrender_serialize 0.9.0 · anyrender_skia 0.13.0 · anyrender_vello 0.16.0 · anyrender_vello_cpu 0.19.0 · anyrender_vello_gpu 0.12.0 · anyrender_svg 0.16.0 · wgpu_context 0.11.0`), with `vello 0.12`, `vello_cpu`/`vello_gpu`/`vello_common 0.4`, `usvg 0.50.0`; `cargo update -w` exits 0, the lock's changed package lines 49 (`git diff --cached -- Cargo.lock`, name/version pairs), `zip v2.4.2 -> v9.6.1`, no Stylo, winit, parley, Dioxus or Taffy move. Every newly resolved crate that states a `rust-version` states ≤ 1.89 (glifo · vello · vello_cpu · vello_common 1.89; zip 9.6.1 and sha2 0.11.1 1.88; usvg, skrifa, read-fonts 1.85); the AnyRender crates state none.

- **The port, semantics kept:** `AntiAliasing` (anyrender-0.15.0 `src/types.rs:32`) defaults to `Enabled` ("Edges are anti-aliased"), so each of the 47 blitz-paint calls cargo reports missing it (`fill`/`stroke` 46, `draw_glyphs` 1 — `render.rs` 9, `form_controls.rs` 9, `text.rs` 8, `border.rs` 7, `select_list.rs` 5, `background.rs` 4, `debug_overlay.rs` 3, `box_shadow.rs` 2) takes `anyrender::AntiAliasing::Enabled` as its new last argument, located from cargo's JSON spans (`port_aa.py`), and the 6 outside blitz-paint the same (`wpt/runner` `crash_test.rs`, `ref_test.rs`; `examples/custom_widget.rs`, `examples/screenshot.rs`, `examples/wgpu_texture/src/demo_renderer.rs`; `apps/browser/src/capture.rs`). `draw_box_shadow` (anyrender-0.14.0 `lib.rs:252`: `transform, rect, brush, radius, std_dev`; 0.15.0 `lib.rs:287`: `transform, &NonUniformRoundedRect, offset, spread, std_dev, color, BoxShadowKind`) takes, at both sites of `render/box_shadow.rs` (:83, :146), the same rect and radius as `RoundedRect::from_rect(rect, radius).into()`, offset `Vec2::ZERO`, spread `0.0`, the same std_dev and colour, and `BoxShadowKind::OutsetUnclipped` ("also painted underneath the box", the old unclipped blur). `Filter::linear_list` takes the filter's bounds (image_filters_types 0.1.0 `lib.rs:97`): `convert_filters` takes `bounds: Rect`, and `render.rs` passes `cx.frame.border_box_path().bounding_box()`, its `effect_layer_clip` starting from the same value — upstream's own form at `e5305a4c1` (`git show upstream/main:packages/blitz-paint/src/{filters,render}.rs`). The hybrid renderer's types are `VelloGpu*` now (`anyrender_vello_gpu-0.12.0/src/lib.rs:11`); `examples/paint_bench.rs` is upstream's file at `e5305a4c1` as written — ours differed from upstream's base `23b9b26a9` by one line, the lossy UTF-8 read, which upstream's file already carries (:71).

- **Upstream's rename (`92df4760c`, inputs#I3's «the dioxus-native rename»):** the workspace key `anyrender_vello_hybrid` → `anyrender_vello_gpu`, dioxus-native's feature `vello-hybrid` → `vello-gpu`, the apps' and examples' `hybrid` → `vello-gpu`, `wasm_hello` on `VelloGpuWebGlWindowRenderer`, over 24 files upstream. Our sweep reaches 26 files (`git grep -i -E "vello[-_]hybrid|VelloHybrid|features hybrid|\"hybrid\"|^hybrid ="`, outside `Cargo.lock` and the records), `.github/scripts/ci-leg.sh`'s wasm leg (:36–37, `--features hybrid`) among them; no CI-script test, `docs/capabilities.md` or README pins a renderer name (`git grep -i "hybrid\|vello-gpu" -- .github/scripts/*.py docs/capabilities.md README.md scripts/`: 0). The trial kept the old key and features (a type rename alone); the full rename is unmeasured beyond that sweep.

- **Readings on it:** `cargo check --workspace --all-targets` exit 0; `cargo fmt --all -- --check` exit 1 on the inserted argument's line breaks alone (`demo_renderer.rs:69`, `capture.rs:91` — `cargo fmt` writes them); `ci-leg.sh clippy` exit 0; `cargo test --workspace --locked --no-fail-fast` **1546 passed · 1 failed · 15 ignored**, the one failure again `stand_act_scroll` (`e5305a4c1`'s, unchanged); `embolden` · `doc` · `a11y` · `wasm` exit 0; **`audit` exit 0, `advisories ok, licenses ok`**, its log warning that RUSTSEC-2026-0367 · 0368 · 0369 · 0429 match no crate (the ignores now unused). Every check that reads pixels passes — `stand_act_screenshot` 6, `stand_screenshot_repeat` 1, `select_popup_painted` 6, `screenshot` 6, `contrast` 7, `stand_contrast` 7, `stand_lint` 9, `stand_cross_os_readings` 7 among them — none pins a pixel byte (`git grep` for a PNG prefix or a digest literal: the MCP check's `iVBORw0KGgo` prefix and `stand_cross_os_readings`' snapshot/lint/actions digests alone).
- **The screenshot readings (the operator's direction):** a whole-screen `screenshot` of each of the six served tasks through `escher-session` (`shots.py`), HEAD against the take, 800 × 600 each:
| Task | Five-commit take (no AnyRender) | AnyRender take: pixels that differ of 480 000 | max channel delta |
| counter | byte-identical PNG | 644 | 27 |
| flight-booker | byte-identical | 2 259 | 29 |
| timer | byte-identical | 1 335 | 29 |
| crud | byte-identical | 2 618 | 30 |
| cells | byte-identical | 728 | 29 |
| load | byte-identical | 427 | 23 |

The five commits move no pixel; AnyRender 0.15 (vello_cpu 0.4's raster under the same `Enabled` anti-aliasing) moves 0.09 – 0.55 % of each screen by at most 30 of 255 per channel. Where on the screen they fall is unmeasured. No committed artifact holds a shot's pixels (the two Counter checks hold no `screenshot` step; `stand_cross_os_readings` holds no shot), so no committed reading moves.
- **MSRV:** `ci-leg.sh msrv` (`cargo +1.91 build --workspace --locked`) exit 0 on the take, `Finished` (the leg's log).

body:
_Generated by /andromeda-phase P4. Read by /andromeda-implement. Manual edits between runs are fine; do not
edit during an /implement run._
- **Marker:** 2026-11-17-upstream-sync-ahead-of-polish-and-ship · **Version:** escher-0.3.0 · **Generated:** 2026-11-17T13:52:02Z

This is the twelfth upstream take, at `upstream/main` `e5305a4c1`, ten commits past the last take's `ea07ee716`. It opens Epoch 6 «Polish & ship». It has three parts, each measured on the trial worktree `target/tmp/trial-pas` (research §The trial take, §The AnyRender take):

- **Five commits by no-commit pick.** `7b8712cba` (external images for inline and top-level SVG `<image>`/`<use>` `href`), `e8b370a25` and `585c1869c` (WPT only), `d02c094c7` (the synthetic italic shear's direction, one line by hand) and `e5305a4c1` (scroll offsets clamped when final layout is written). Two resolutions keep both sides' intent. This is the shape of (architecture · decision/upstream-taken-by-cherry-pick).

- **AnyRender 0.15 from the registry.** This is upstream's `81b489684` and the `92df4760c` rename, taken on the founder's word «Взять AnyRender 0.15 в этом sync» (`inputs#I5` §1). It brings anyrender_serialize 0.9.0, so zip 2.4.2 → 9.6.1. That cures the red «Dependency audit» of CI#44076271917 on RUSTSEC-2026-0545 and RUSTSEC-2026-0548 (`inputs#I2`), and leaves the four standing zip ignores matching no crate, so they are dropped. blitz-paint is ported with semantics kept: `AntiAliasing::Enabled` (the API's default) at 53 call sites, the box shadow with zero offset and spread under `OutsetUnclipped`, and the filter given its border box as bounds, as upstream wrote it.

- **The CI disk line** the operator asked for (`inputs#I1`, `inputs#I4`). `Test [default features]` gets a `df -h` reading around its test leg and the same SHA-pinned free-disk step `Stand checks repeated` holds. Its next red then reads its own disk, and a green run reads the margin. Disk is measured at one of the two reds and unmeasured at the other (research §The CI disk reds).

Four engine behaviour changes for every document come with the take. Each is ratified on the founder's own word, relayed verbatim (`inputs#I5`), under the routine pattern «An engine behaviour change for every document» (`rul-47a6zcoz`) and (architecture · decision/upstream-behaviour-changes-ratified-per-take):
- the AnyRender 0.15 paint, which moves 0.09–0.55 % of each stand screen's pixels by at most 30 of 255 per channel; no committed artifact holds a pixel;
- the SVG image fetch;
- the shear direction;
- the scroll clamp.

The SVG image fetch is also a boundary widening by upstream merge (`rul-72xhfjoz`). His word «Взять (Recommended)» stands for it, so the wrap halts once on the card that cites `inputs#I5` §2, with no second question to him. One escher reading moves: `stand_act_scroll`'s last two assertions, which pin the unclamped offset. They are re-measured and re-pinned, never loosened.

The chunk's exit is the working entry's: CI, the a11y leg and the audit green, the per-OS tallies re-read, and the sink allowlist re-checked. The seven carries are each re-read, and all seven ride on (scope §Folded freight).

1. **Save HEAD's driver binary, for the shot comparison in step 9.** Run `cargo build -p seven_guis --bin escher-session --locked` on the untouched tree. Copy `target/debug/escher-session` to `.andromeda/cache/chunks/2026-11-17-upstream-sync-ahead-of-polish-and-ship/evidence/escher-session.head`. Copy research's comparison script `.andromeda/runs/2026-11-17T11-43-12-phase/shots.py` (a whole-screen `screenshot` of each served task through two binaries, a PNG decode, the differing-pixel count and the largest channel delta; arguments: the project root, then the two binaries) to `.andromeda/cache/chunks/2026-11-17-upstream-sync-ahead-of-polish-and-ship/evidence/shots.py`.

2. **Pick the five commits onto the working tree, in upstream order**, each `git -c rerere.enabled=false cherry-pick --no-commit {sha}` from the project root (host-linux.md Session Additions 2026-10-27). After each resolution, `git add` the resolved files before the next pick.
   - `7b8712cba`. One conflict in `packages/blitz-dom/src/node/serialize.rs`: upstream's side is a `#[cfg(all(test, feature = "svg"))] mod tests` that tests the left-out `8228d15f3`, and ours is empty. Keep ours, dropping that module. Nothing else conflicts. The fetch goes through `BaseDocument::build_request` (`document.rs:660`), so no `Request::get` enters blitz-dom (`cry-fdvxodkv`).
   - `e8b370a25`: clean.
   - `d02c094c7`: re-apply by hand as the one sign change at `packages/blitz-paint/src/text.rs:641`, `Affine::skew(angle…` → `Affine::skew(-angle…`. Its `parley_code_editor` half has no file here.
   - `585c1869c`: clean.
   - `e5305a4c1`. Two conflicts:
     - `packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs` `flush_pending_device_changes`: keep ours minus the one line `self.scroll_viewport_by(0.0, 0.0); // Clamp scroll offset`, which upstream deletes. Its side's `make_media_data`/`restyle_for_device_change` belong to the left-out stylo chain.
     - `packages/blitz-dom/src/scrolling.rs` imports: `use crate::{BaseDocument, BoundingRect, Node};`.
     - Graph impact: `scroll_viewport_by`'s one caller is `flush_pending_device_changes` @ `packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:2720`, the dropped line (research §Graph impact).
   - The trial read this take at 18 files, +291 −157 (`git diff --cached --stat c74c7f3e6750fd51a57f8c0910898b890ae8694c`).

4. **Port blitz-paint and the other painters to the AnyRender 0.15 API, with semantics kept** (research §The AnyRender take):
   - `fill`, `stroke` and `draw_glyphs` take `anyrender::AntiAliasing::Enabled` as their new last argument at each site cargo reports missing it:
     - 47 in blitz-paint: `render.rs` 9, `render/form_controls.rs` 9, `text.rs` 8, `render/border.rs` 7, `render/select_list.rs` 5, `render/background.rs` 4, `debug_overlay.rs` 3, `render/box_shadow.rs` 2;
     - 6 outside: `wpt/runner/src/test_runners/crash_test.rs`, `ref_test.rs`, `examples/custom_widget.rs`, `examples/screenshot.rs`, `examples/wgpu_texture/src/demo_renderer.rs` and `apps/browser/src/capture.rs`.
   - `render/box_shadow.rs`'s two `draw_box_shadow` calls (:83, :146) keep their rect, radius, std_dev and colour: `&kurbo::RoundedRect::from_rect(rect, radius).into()`, `Vec2::ZERO`, `0.0`, the same std_dev, the colour, and `anyrender::BoxShadowKind::OutsetUnclipped`.
   - `filters.rs` `convert_filters` takes `bounds: kurbo::Rect` and passes it to `Filter::linear_list`. In `render.rs` the effect layer computes `let border_box = cx.frame.border_box_path().bounding_box();` once, passes it to both `convert_filters` calls, and starts `effect_layer_clip` from it. This is upstream's form at `e5305a4c1`.

7. **Re-pin `stand_act_scroll`'s last two assertions** (`tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_scroll.rs:248–256`) to the clamped reading:
   - On the take, after the delete, read the first row's centre against `crud-list`'s box and the list's own scroll offset, in both layout modes.
   - Write both as measured literals (testing.md: a check never derives its expected value from what its mutation changes).
   - The refusal or acceptance of a click on `crud-person-0` follows the reading: refused `off-screen` while outside, accepted while inside.
   - The control (one-shot, `gate.py control --timeout 900`): fire the `cargo test -p blitz-tests --locked --test stand_act_scroll` entry with the clamp's call in `packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/construct.rs` removed (the `clamp_node_scroll_offset` line `e5305a4c1` adds). The kill is 900 s: the target builds incrementally and its six cases run under 1 s. A `timeout` reading is no hold; it is re-fired.

8. **Witness the SVG fetch's stamp** in `tests/blitz-tests/tests/local_files_for_local_documents.rs` `every_engine_request_carries_its_document_as_initiator`:
   - Add `<svg width="10" height="10"><image href="file:///stamp/svgimg.png" width="10" height="10"/></svg>` to the page.
   - Add `"svgimg.png"` to `expected` in sorted order, and the length pin `7` → `8`.

   - The loop already holds every request's initiator to the remote document.
   - Control (one-shot, `gate.py control --timeout 900`): fire the `cargo test -p blitz-tests --locked --test local_files_for_local_documents` entry with the `fetch_image` call `7b8712cba` adds for an SVG `href` removed (in `packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs` or `document.rs`, wherever the take leaves the SVG arm). # The seven carries, re-read against the taken tree — 2026-11-17-upstream-sync-ahead-of-polish-and-ship

Each row was read on the take's working tree against base `c74c7f3e6750fd51a57f8c0910898b890ae8694c`.
`git diff --name-only c74c7f3e6750fd51a57f8c0910898b890ae8694c -- packages/` names blitz-dom's `Cargo.toml`, `document.rs`,
`layout/construct.rs`, `layout/mod.rs`, `mutator.rs`, `net.rs`, `node/element.rs`, `resolve.rs`, `scrolling.rs` and
`util.rs`; blitz-paint's `debug_overlay.rs`, `filters.rs`, `render.rs`, `render/{background,border,box_shadow,form_controls,select_list}.rs`
and `text.rs`; and dioxus-native's `Cargo.toml`, `src/dioxus_renderer.rs` and `src/lib.rs` (the rename). No
`dioxus-native-dom`, `blitz-shell`, `events/`, `accessibility.rs`, `node/node.rs`, `node/select.rs`, `node/range.rs`,
`clock.rs` or `layout/inline/` file is in the delta.

Across `packages`,
`^[+-].*(changed_nodes|select_list|select_typeahead|VirtualClock|clock\(|is_inert|clear_focus|keyboard|deallocate_anonymous_block|hit_inner|handle_click|Request::get|StylesheetHandler|fetch_font_face|stamped_request|build_request)`
reads 8: the `net` import lines of `document.rs` and `mutator.rs` (`ImageHandler` moves from `mutator.rs`'s import to
`document.rs`'s; `StylesheetHandler` stays imported, no construction moves), `fetch_image`'s `self.build_request(url)`
(the stamped constructor) and the `self.doc.build_request(src)` line it replaces in `mutator.rs`'s `load_image`, and the
two diff header lines of `blitz-paint/src/render/select_list.rs` (its five `AntiAliasing::Enabled` arguments). None
reaches a surface below.

## The merge surfaces (`cry-blhcfqeb`), row by row

| Surface | Kept | Resolution | The check that reads it |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deallocate_anonymous_block` | kept | untouched: `document.rs`' three hunks are the `net` import, `fetch_image` (added after `build_request`, `:662`) and the one dropped clamp line in `flush_pending_device_changes` | `anonymous_block_leak`, `anonymous_block_transform`, `incremental_oracle` |
| The hit stops (`node/node.rs`, `hit_inner`) | kept | untouched: no hunk in `node/node.rs` | `hit_clipped_at_scrolling_box`, `hit_non_invertible_transform`, `scrolled_box_client_rect`, `hit_inline_embedded_box` |
| The clock (`clock.rs`, `VirtualClock`) | kept | untouched: no hunk | `virtual_clock_engine`, `stand_virtual_clock` |
| The select model and its list (`node/select.rs`, `select_list.rs`, `select_list` field) | kept | the model untouched; blitz-paint's `render/select_list.rs` takes `AntiAliasing::Enabled` at its 5 `fill`/`stroke` calls, nothing else | `select_interaction`, `select_popup`, `select_popup_painted`, `stand_act_select`, `stand_act_popup` |
| The range and keyboard models (`node/range.rs`, `events/keyboard.rs`) | kept | untouched: no hunk | `range_input_interaction`, `stand_keyboard` |
| `inert` (`is_inert`, `clear_focus` in `DocumentMutator::flush`) | kept | untouched: `mutator.rs`' hunks are the SVG `href` arms, `load_image`'s move to `fetch_image`, `is_data_url` and `process_removed_subtree`'s new `reset_node_scroll_state` call | `inert_subtree` |
| The accessibility state reads (`accessibility.rs`) | kept | untouched: no hunk | `accessibility_states`, `stand_snapshot_state` |
| The checkable `change` event (`handle_click`'s arms) | kept | untouched: no `events/pointer.rs` hunk | `checkable_change_event` |
| The unresolvable-href guard | kept | `fetch_image` resolves through `build_request`'s existing path; no `resolve_url` or `resolve_relative` site of the stylesheet guard moves | `render_blocking_stylesheet` |
| The reversed scroll origins and the into-view readings (`scrolling.rs`) | kept | `e5305a4c1` adds `node_scroll_range` and four `pub(crate)` clamp functions and moves `scroll_state`'s per-axis range read into `node_scroll_range`, same arms; `scroll_into_view` and `visible_region` keep their bodies; imports merged | `scroll_into_view_nested`, `visible_region_transformed`, `stand_act_scroll` (re-pinned, step 7) |
| The buffered render (dioxus-native-dom, blitz-shell `window.rs`) | kept | untouched: the take reaches no `dioxus-native-dom` or `blitz-shell` file | `stand_accessibility_ids`, the stand checks |

Every row stands as the last take read it bar the scroll row, which `e5305a4c1` widens by its clamp; the upstreamable
flags are unchanged and nothing was sent.

## The seven carries

| Carry | Reading at this take | Disposition |
|---|---|---|
| `cry-o26emj4y` (mounted-event test) | Dioxus stays 0.7.3 (`Cargo.toml`'s `dioxus` line unchanged; no Dioxus package in the lock delta) | rides on to the Dioxus 0.8 move |
| `cry-mnnoitsu` (buffered render's merge surface) | no 0.8 move; no `dioxus-native-dom` file in the delta | rides on |
| `cry-hvl3d4gp` (`handle_click`'s arm functions) | no taken commit edits `events/pointer.rs` | rides on |
| `cry-fdvxodkv` (the `Request::get` ban) | `7b8712cba`'s `fetch_image` builds its request through `BaseDocument::build_request` and adds no `Request::get` (census entry 6, `evidence/sink.md`); no `StylesheetHandler` construction or `fetch_font_face` caller moves; the clippy leg runs with the ban in force (the `fast` leg) | rides on |
| `cry-blhcfqeb` (merge surfaces) | the table above, row by row | rides on to the next upstream sync |
| `cry-7rsyw6me` (CDP listener) | `a1670ef1b` is not among the 10 and is still carried (a pin mover, `evidence/lock.md`); no listener arrives | rides on |
| `cry-hbkcvbxr` (Taffy merge surface) | upstream's pin at `e5305a4c1` is our git Taffy `a3997d55bacd1fb6cd12fe31db0be15b20f91528`; no taffy package and no `layout/inline/layout.rs` hunk in the delta, so `place_floated_box`'s line stands | rides on |

title: evidence/shots.py
body:
"""Whole-screen shot of each served task through escher-session, on two binaries; compare pixels.
argv: repo_root, head_bin, trial_bin. State dirs are relative (socket path bound), under target/tmp."""
import base64, hashlib, json, os, subprocess, sys, zlib, struct, shutil

root, head_bin, trial_bin = sys.argv[1:4]
os.chdir(root)
TASKS = ["counter", "flight-booker", "timer", "crud", "cells", "load"]

def run(binary, *args):
    p = subprocess.run([binary, *args], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.strip()

def decode_png(data):
    assert data[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
    pos, idat, w = 8, b"", None
    while pos < len(data):
        n = struct.unpack(">I", data[pos:pos + 4])[0]
        t = data[pos + 4:pos + 8]
        body = data[pos + 8:pos + 8 + n]
        if t == b"IHDR":
            w, h, depth, ctype = struct.unpack(">IIBB", body[:10])
        elif t == b"IDAT":
            idat += body
        pos += 12 + n
    assert depth == 8 and ctype in (2, 6)
    bpp = 3 if ctype == 2 else 4
    raw = zlib.decompress(idat)
    stride = w * bpp
    rows, prev, i = [], bytearray(stride), 0
    for _ in range(h):
        f = raw[i]; line = bytearray(raw[i + 1:i + 1 + stride]); i += 1 + stride
        for x in range(stride):
            a = line[x - bpp] if x >= bpp else 0
            b = prev[x]; c = prev[x - bpp] if x >= bpp else 0
            if f == 1: line[x] = (line[x] + a) & 255
            elif f == 2: line[x] = (line[x] + b) & 255
            elif f == 3: line[x] = (line[x] + (a + b) // 2) & 255
            elif f == 4:
                p = a + b - c; pa, pb, pc = abs(p - a), abs(p - b), abs(p - c)
                line[x] = (line[x] + (a if pa <= pb and pa <= pc else b if pb <= pc else c)) & 255
        rows.append(bytes(line)); prev = line
    return w, h, bpp, rows

def shot(binary, task, tag):
    d = f"target/tmp/shot-{tag}-{task}"
    shutil.rmtree(d, ignore_errors=True)
    os.makedirs(d, mode=0o700)
    rc, out = run(binary, "start", task, "--session", d)
    assert rc == 0, (task, tag, rc, out[:200])
    rc, out = run(binary, "screenshot", "--session", d)
    run(binary, "stop", "--session", d)
    shutil.rmtree(d, ignore_errors=True)
    assert rc == 0, (task, tag, rc, out[:200])
    return base64.b64decode(json.loads(out)["png"])

for task in TASKS:
    a, b = shot(head_bin, task, "head"), shot(trial_bin, task, "trial")
    if a == b:
        print(f"{task}: identical PNG ({len(a)} B, sha256 {hashlib.sha256(a).hexdigest()[:12]})")
        continue
    wa, ha, bpa, ra = decode_png(a); wb, hb, bpb, rb = decode_png(b)
    diff, maxd = 0, 0
    for y in range(min(ha, hb)):
        for x in range(min(wa, wb)):
            pa = ra[y][x * bpa:x * bpa + 3]; pb = rb[y][x * bpb:x * bpb + 3]
            if pa != pb:
                diff += 1; maxd = max(maxd, max(abs(pa[k] - pb[k]) for k in range(3)))
    print(f"{task}: differs — {wa}x{ha} vs {wb}x{hb}, {diff} of {wa*ha} pixels differ, max channel delta {maxd}")

scroll min and max are both zero, then the viewport — a nested box at once, the requested behaviour for the viewport alone — and on a row of an open select list writes the list's `scroll_y` at once and returns, moving no chain and no viewport; `visible_region` reads the part of the viewport an element can be seen through — never a hit — and for a row or a group of an open select list the list's or `radio` `input`, whose own `checkbox_input_checked()` writes `Toggled::True` or `False` under a checkable role and nothing under any other, an engine change for every document (the toggle read per among the built nodes, else `u64::MAX`, the window, so the tree never names a node it did not build, an engine change for every document), `BoundingRect`, the public crate-root `TRACING_COMPILED` (true when the engine's `tracing` feature is compiled in), the layout reason's public read types re-exported from the crate root (the structs `LayoutReason`, `Placed`, `Shift`, `SizeReason`, crate root) and the public `ElementData` accessors `range_input_data()`, `range_input_data_mut()` and `range_input_value() -> Option<String>` (the formatted current value), `RangeRules`, `RangeMove` for the `sans-serif` generic, through fontique's `generic_families`) and `BaseDocument::layout_as_text_input(&self, node_id, text) -> Option<parley::Layout<TextBrush>>` (`text` laid out with a text input's editor styles, scale and direction in the document's own fonts, one unbroken line, a fresh `LayoutContext` per call, `None` for a node that is no text input — its two callers are blitz-paint's password mask and blitz-dom's password click caret (`click_password_input`)), and a third read-only reader, `BaseDocument::text_extent(&self, NodeId) -> Option<TextExtent>` with `TextExtent { content, text }` (two `BoundingRect`s, re-exported from the crate root): `content` the client rect less border, padding and any scrollbar, `text` from the content box's top-left moved down by the inline layout's `block_offset` and sized by Parley `Layout::width()` / `height()` over its scale, `None` for an id that does not resolve, a node that is no inline root or one with no inline layout data — it word, container, offset, shifts, a size reason per axis with its cause), or `None` for an unresolved id, a non-element, an element with no computed styles or one with no box (display none, display contents, a display none ancestor), with no log and no panic. Every package install of ci.yml goes through `.github/scripts/apt-install.sh` — up to 3 attempts, each `apt-get` call under a 120 s bound, every attempt after the first opening since 2026-10-14-quality-gates with a bounded repair, `dpkg --configure -a` in phase `repair` (a failed repair failing that attempt), exits 0 · 1 · 2 — and the matrix job's apt-cache action step carries `timeout-minutes: 10`; the stand-in tests are the bound's one witness, no CI run has shown it fire (green in CI run 37985678276, where eight jobs ran the script). `cargo` stops at the first failing target, so a red job's later targets go unread on that run.
